## Type of change
- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] refactor — code restructuring without behavior change
- [ ] test — tests only
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] chore — tooling, lint, deps, housekeeping

## Checklist
- [ ] Conventional commit messages (`type(scope): description`)
- [ ] Branch is based on `develop` (not `main`)
- [ ] `npm test` passes in `backend/` and `frontend/`
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes in `frontend/` (and `backend/` if applicable)
- [ ] No `console.log` debug leftovers, commented-out code, or unused imports
- [ ] New UI/API behavior has acceptance criteria covered
